lines.text: > subject status at time of record: deceased
Good news. That was the old you.
You are a semi-organic fabrication built to resemble the person who died.
The resemblance is rated 'convincing at conversational distance'.
Some memories were recovered. Some were reconstructed. We will not say which.
Nobody has explained the battle. Nobody intends to.
You can do this. That is not encouragement. It is the product name.
